# authwise_guard_relays (Data Source)

A relay a Guard network's nodes connect through when no direct path exists. guard-control serves a network's relays to its nodes, lowest `priority` first. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) The Guard tenant's id, `authwise_guard_tenant.<name>.guard_tenant_id` (`gt-…`); the provider's `tenant_id` is not used.

### Optional

- `network_id` (String) Parent identifier `network_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `guard_relays` (Attributes List) Every relay under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guard_relays))

<a id="nestedatt--guard_relays"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guard_relays`

Read-Only:

- `ca_cert_pem` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `guard_relay_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `last_seen_at` (String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `priority` (Number)
- `region` (String)
- `url` (String)
